chunks: They had tried to create disorder before and intrigued against you, but truth came out in the end and God's will prevailed, even though they did not like it.
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers try to do before the truth prevailed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the strategic political maneuvering of the Quraysh and early hypocrites who sought to destabilize the nascent Islamic community by turning affairs against the Prophet. Their persistent efforts to create *fitnah* ultimately failed as divine truth (*al-Haqq*) manifested, fulfilling the Shia emphasis on the inevitability of God's decree despite human resistance. This serves as a theological precedent for the endurance of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams against opposing forces.
